profile.headline: Software Engineer at Onsemi | Java | Python
profile.summary:
Seasoned engineer with 5+ years of industry experience specializing in building scalable backend applications, distributed systems, data-driven models and microservices architectures. Proficient in Java, Python, and cloud platforms like AWS, I am passionate about leveraging technology to solve complex business problems and drive meaningful outcomes.

I’m open to connecting with fellow engineers and engaging in conversations. I'd love to discuss technology, share ideas, or explore potential collaborations.

Additionally, if you're a new student or just starting out in Tech, feel free to reach out—I’d be more than happy to chat or help in any way I can.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented scalable REST APIs for retail financing using Flask, Azure Functions and WhatsApp for Business integration, handling over 5,000 daily transactions, resulting in a 60% increase in processing speed and a $50K boost in monthly revenue.
- Built a Python application to automate business logic functions for generating sales forecasting and inventory management reports, eliminating dependency on Excel spreadsheets and resulting in a 20% reduction in man-hours per month for the client.
- Cut deployment time by 15% by executing 10+ unit and integration tests, ensuring robust production code quality.
- Engineered CI/CD pipelines and conducted code reviews using GitHub and GitHub Actions, streamlining project setup.
positions.insights: Machine Learning, API Development and +10 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data science
positions.description:
As a senior member of the Data Science team, my primary responsibility was to ensure the successful execution of client-facing data science projects while delivering customized solutions aligned with business goals. My role involved a combination of project management, client communication, and technical implementation to drive impactful data-driven decisions.

Key Achievements and Responsibilities:
- Led the development of a scalable Python service for credit default prediction, integrating an 87% accurate Logistic Regression model, cutting costs by 30%, and doubling loan approval speed.
- Built an 82% accurate sentiment analysis model for client feedback, deploying a Flask API to power real-time customer insights.
- Managed engineers, handled project oversight, client communication, code reviews, and documentation via JIRA.
- Successfully onboarded and mentored 3+ new hires while improving team collaboration and efficiency by 30%.
- Facilitated knowledge-sharing sessions and fostered a collaborative work environment.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Project Management and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer, Data Science
positions.description:
- Developed and trained deep learning vision and text models to extract over 50 attributes from product discount images across 100+ product types with 94% accuracy, enriching product data and improving client pricing strategies.
-  Engineered end-to-end ETL pipelines for feature extraction and data preprocessing, cutting the project lifecycle by 25% and facilitating faster model training and deployment.
- Additionally. took responsibility for creating dashboards and reports using Tableau and MySql for the firm's clients.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Deep Learning and +12 skills

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
- Demonstrated a Transformer model PoC achieving 82% accuracy, to generate legal text summaries and classify legal cases.
- Developed a custom data extraction solution leveraging Selenium to retrieve legal case documents from selected list of websites.
positions.insights: Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP) and +3 skills

educations.fieldOfStudy: Information Technology (IT) from LJ institute of Engineering and Technology
